result.rationale: The diff lowercases only blacklist entries (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but compares the raw guest string (`blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`) and existing attendees case-sensitively (`guest === attendee.email`), so emails differing in case bypass the blacklist and duplicate-attendee filter. Mechanism is fully verifiable in addGuests.handler.ts.
